title: The Latest Crier for Feb 23, 2026
items:
ZY Sweets For Your Sweetie Fundraiser

Buy some Sweets for your Sweetie from Zeta Upsilon Feb 9-12, from 5-8 pm in the Maytag Atrium for only $3! You can choose between chocolate candies, fruit-flavored candies, or a mix to show how well you know your Sweetie!

Aluminum Can Drive for Lake View Camp!!

Calling all pop, Bublr, Monster, V8 lovers.. WE WANT YOUR ALUMINUM CANS! During the month of February we will be collecting aluminum cans & taking them to the Redemption Center to collect $$ for Lake View Camp. All proceeds will go toward sponsoring kids to attend a life changing week of summer camp! Find boxes located in Vermeer, Weller, Lower Chapel, Central Hall, & Maytag. Lasts through 2/25.

New Book for Book Club!

On Monday, February 23rd, we will be voting for a new book to read for Book Club! Everyone who shows up will get a chance to recommend a book and vote for the one we read! The category for this book is Nonfiction! 
We will meet at 7 pm on Monday, February 23rd, in Weller 201. If you have any questions, please email andersonr3@central.edu

Late Night Central Art Event: Altered Books | Friday, Feb. 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag

Friday, February 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag Student Center 
All students are welcome to join us for this one-of-a-kind special Late Night Central event. Mary Robertson will guide us through an art project called Altered Books. This is a visual storytelling medium that allows you to explore and engage with the diverse world of arts and culture. Taking inspiration from underrepresented artists and influenced by graffiti and textured collages, we will have fun, create art, and tell stories by exploring the process of Altered Books.

The Leprechaun’s Heist: Escape the Room

A leprechaun has swiped your gold—do you have what it takes to get it back? Gather a team of up to four for a high-stakes, 30-minute race against the clock. Solve riddles, crack codes, and outwit the luck of the Irish! 

Date: Sunday, March 1 

Time: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Arrive 10 minutes early) 

Location: BMW Rooms 

The fastest team wins a grand prize and campus-wide bragging rights. Spots are limited—sign up now! (must use central email in order to sign up)

Planning to stay in Pella this summer? Need a place to live?

Click here to find out more information about on-campus housing and fill out the summer student facility use contract. Space is limited so fill out the form and pay your first two weeks' rent by Wednesday, April 1st to reserve your spot. Contact Sarah Lunsford (lunsfords@central.edu) if you have any questions.

COMMEMORATING BLACK HISTORY AND WOMEN'S HISTORY MONTHS

Join History Club in Van Emmerik Studio on Wednesday night for a movie commemorating both Black History month (February) and Women's History month (March). 7:00pm. Bring your friends!

STUDENT TRUSTEE SPOTS OPEN!

Student Trustee Applications are OPEN NOW and due March 6th at 5pm 
What is a Student Trustee? 

- A non-voting representative to the Board of Trustees and the voice for students during important decision-making processes 

How do I apply? 

- The application can be found in your Central email from ssenate@central.eduIt or at MyCentral > Student Life > Student Senate 

Who are the current Student Trustees? 

- Parker Lawrence, Madison Craig, Elyse Shaw, Cassie Elliott, and Mya Ehresman

The Calm: worship, message, community, & sometimes snacks :)

Feeling overwhelmed? Discouraged? Anxious for the start of the week?! Then start your week off right by joining us for Sunday night worship at THE CALM, 8:30 pm in the Upper Chapel! We will be diving in to the book of John. Enjoy worship, a message, & community. All are welcome. We would love to see you!

Paid Student Leader Positions for Fall 2026

Lead. Serve. Get Paid. Apply now for paid student leader positions for Fall 2026 : CAB | RA | SOS Make an impact on campus and grow your leadership skills. Apply by March 1! Link to Apply: https://app.joinhandshake.com/e/1010657/jobs

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Free Home-Cooked Lent Breakfast!

Join us every Wednesday morning from 7-7:45 am in the Lower Chapel starting 2/25 until 4/1 for some good home-cooked breakfast. Breakfast is provided by a local church, along with a devo, & wonderful community to start your Wednesday right!

HLC Visit Coming

Central College will host a team from the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) for a scheduled accreditation visit the week of Feb. 22–25. HLC is a national accrediting body that evaluates colleges and universities to confirm they meet established standards for educational quality, governance, financial stability and institutional effectiveness. During the visit, the HLC team may speak with students, faculty and staff to better understand the Central experience. We share this information to keep you informed and to reassure you that this is a planned, routine visit that supports Central’s commitment to excellence and accountability.

First Date

Join us in the Kruidenier Center February 26th-28th at 7pm and March 1st at 2pm for the Visual & Performing Arts production of First Date. 
When blind date newbie Aaron is set up with serial-dater Casey, a casual drink at a busy New York restraunt turns into a hilarious high-stakes dinner. Can this couple turn what could be a dating disaster into something special before the check arrives? 

For tickets go to https://central.universitytickets.com

HISTORY CLUB TONIGHT!

Everyone invited! Get your dinner in the Market and join us in the side room nearest the cashier. Catch up and hear news of upcoming events. What's our game this week? 5:30 - 7:00pm. Come and go as you are able.
